name: recover_pose
description:
Return selected arms to a known joint configuration while preserving gripper commands.
Use when: a refused or interrupted motion left an arm in a poor configuration and ordinary pose correction is not appropriate. home returns to the joint configuration the arm held when the current round started; previous returns to the configuration it held just before the latest pose motion started executing.
Effect: world mutation; a straight joint-space move, checked tick by tick for table clearance and the distance between the arms before anything moves. Omitted arms are not commanded; two arms move together.
Returns: submitted strategies immediately; the next receipt and fresh observation report the plan, execution status and measured pose.
Does not: reset the scene, restore moved objects, open or close a gripper, avoid objects on the table, or act as an emergency stop.
On error: recovery_state_unavailable means no pose motion has executed yet for previous; use home. A refused plan moved nothing and detail.admission_refusal.check names the check: recover one arm at a time or move the other arm away first.

targets.description: Non-empty per-arm recovery strategies. Omitted arms are not commanded.

left.description: The left arm's strategy: home is its joint configuration when the current round started; previous is its configuration just before the latest pose motion started executing. Neither changes its gripper command. Null means omitted.

right.description: The right arm's strategy: home is its joint configuration when the current round started; previous is its configuration just before the latest pose motion started executing. Neither changes its gripper command. Null means omitted.
